format:

extensions:
  badge:
    - key: stable
      colour: springgreen
    - key: experimental
      class: bg-info
    - key: release
      colour: dodgerblue
      icon: tag
      href: https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-badge/releases/tag/{{value}}
      target: _blank
      title: "Open release {{value}} in a new tab"
---

Define each kind of badge once under `extensions.badge`, then write `{{{< badge key value >}}}` wherever the label belongs.

Version {{< badge stable 2.5.0 >}} marks what has shipped, {{< badge experimental alpha >}} marks what is not settled yet, and {{< badge release 2.5.0 >}} links to the release it names.

## {{< badge stable 2.5.0 >}} Badges in headings

A badge renders inside a heading too, which is where a version or status label usually belongs.

Full documentation: <https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-badge/>.
